pages.name: French Defense: Winawer Variation, Alekhine Gambit, Alatortsev Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 had a ...Nd7-f8-e6 route through the f8-rook. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling in plans 1-2.

pages.name: French: Winawer, Advance, 4...Ne7
pages.notes: Plan 4 had a3 and b4 with Black's bishop on b4; plan 1 called Black's weakened squares light. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling in overview and plans 2-3.

pages.name: French: Winawer, Petrosian, 5.a3
pages.notes: Overview said 4...Qd7 prepares to recapture on c3 with the queen; plan 1 had Bxc3 and bxc3 written so they read as moves now. Rewrote overview and plan 1; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: French: Winawer, 4.e5 b6 5.a3 Bf8
pages.notes: Plan 2 had a ...a6-Ba7 route and redeployed the light-squared bishop via d6 (the f8-bishop is dark-squared). Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French: Winawer, Advance, 4...Ne7 5.Bd2 b6
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 fianchettoed the bishop to b7 to press e5 (the d5-pawn blocks it); plan 2 had 'Be2/d3', read as a pawn move. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: French: Winawer, Petrosian, 5.a3 Bxc3+ 6.bxc3 b6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had ...Bb7 pressing an e4-pawn that does not exist; plan 3 had an e7-f5 route for a knight still on g8; plan 4 called the b-file open (Black's pawn is on b6). Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French: Winawer, Advance, 5.dxc5
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Black using the bishop pair after a Bxc3 White cannot play. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French: Winawer, Bogoljubow, 5...Ne7
pages.notes: Plan 4 had Bxc3 as a move White can play now. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: French: Winawer, Bogoljubow, 5...cxd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White recapturing on d4 'via Nb3' (no knight can reach b3); the main idea is Nb5. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: French: Winawer, Bogoljubow, 5...Ne7 6.dxc5
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Nxc5 from a c6-knight, which cannot reach c5. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in plan 3.
